core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nadheer is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Warner, one who warns”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nadheer corresponds to the Arabic form نَذِير (Arabic root ن ذ ر (n-dh-r); نَذِير (Nadhīr)). Its core sense is nadheer; warner, one who warns. Nadheer is Arabic نَذِير (Nadhīr) 'warner, one who warns', from the root ن ذ ر (n-dh-r). The source gloss 'Observer, Watcher' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as nadhir.
